scenes.text: Imagine standing in a beautiful, fifty square mile pine forest deep inside Yellowstone National Park where you could technically commit the ultimate crime and legally walk away completely free.
Known widely as the Zone of Death, this terrifying place actually exists due to a bizarre constitutional loophole because this strip of wild land is in Idaho, but the court sits in Wyoming.

According to the sixth amendment of the United States Constitution, a criminal jury must be selected exclusively from the state and district where the crime occurred, but absolutely nobody lives in this specific sector.
This creates a massive, unresolved legal loophole where a trial is physically impossible, so make sure to hit follow and tell me in the comments if you would ever risk camping here.
